title: [Amazon Business] Sihoo B300-PRO-M101 Ergonomic Office Chair, High Back Mesh Desk Chair $169.99 Delivered @ Sihoo Amazon AU
body:

[Mortin] I have seen ppl on YouTube complaining about the hand rest bending and eventually breaking as you gut up from the chair.
I went with the Sihoo M57 for $229.99. Feels solid and sturdy
[OPgb] Not sure which one you are comparing to (maybe b100)
But this one seems to be a newer version which is essentially engineered to capture the exact high-end mechanics of the older C300 Pro (high-end) but uses lighter, updated structural polymers to lower production costs and retail price (according to AI)
